Foreseen Throw.name: Foreseen Throw
Foreseen Throw.description: The user throws a small heavy object, a paperweight, a stone, a stapler, at the spot an opponent they have read today will be in a moment. It strikes them there before they can guard and deals bludgeoning damage; held back, it is a stinging knock that staggers them. It works only against a person the user read today, and the user needs a hand-sized object to throw. Strain: light.
